## The problem

What are you trying to do that pix makes hard or impossible today?

## The idea

What you would like it to do. If it is a skill or agent, describe the trigger and
the behavior. If it is a launcher command, sketch the verb and flags.

## Alternatives

Anything you tried or considered.

## Scope

- [ ] This is generic (belongs in the public tree)
- [ ] This is company-specific (belongs in a private pack; see docs/design/packs.md)
